nodes.title: Derivatives
nodes.mastery_criteria: Student can compute derivatives using the limit definition and interpret the derivative as a rate of change and slope.

nodes.title: Power Rule
nodes.mastery_criteria: Student can differentiate polynomial and power functions using the power rule.

nodes.title: Chain Rule
nodes.mastery_criteria: Student can differentiate composite functions using the chain rule.

nodes.title: Product Rule
nodes.mastery_criteria: Student can differentiate products of functions using the product rule.

nodes.title: Quotient Rule
nodes.mastery_criteria: Student can differentiate quotients of functions using the quotient rule.

nodes.title: Implicit Differentiation
nodes.mastery_criteria: Student can use implicit differentiation to find derivatives of implicitly defined relations.

nodes.title: Related Rates
nodes.mastery_criteria: Student can set up and solve related-rates problems using implicit differentiation.

nodes.title: Applications of Derivatives
nodes.mastery_criteria: Student can apply derivatives to analyze motion, extrema, and curve behavior.

nodes.title: Optimization
nodes.mastery_criteria: Student can solve optimization problems by finding and classifying critical points.

nodes.title: Integrals
nodes.mastery_criteria: Student can evaluate definite and indefinite integrals and interpret the integral as area and accumulation.

nodes.title: Definite and Indefinite Integrals
nodes.mastery_criteria: Student can distinguish definite from indefinite integrals and evaluate definite integrals using the Fundamental Theorem.

nodes.title: Fundamental Theorem of Calculus
nodes.mastery_criteria: Student can state and apply both parts of the Fundamental Theorem of Calculus to evaluate integrals and differentiate integral-defined functions.

nodes.title: Area Between Curves
nodes.mastery_criteria: Student can compute the area between two curves using definite integrals.

nodes.title: Volumes of Revolution
nodes.mastery_criteria: Student can compute volumes of solids of revolution using the disk, washer, and shell methods.

nodes.title: U-Substitution
nodes.mastery_criteria: Student can evaluate integrals using u-substitution.

nodes.title: Integration by Parts
nodes.mastery_criteria: Student can evaluate integrals using integration by parts.

nodes.title: Integration Techniques
nodes.mastery_criteria: Student can select and apply appropriate integration techniques, including trigonometric substitution and partial fractions.

nodes.title: Trigonometric Substitution
nodes.mastery_criteria: Student can evaluate integrals using trigonometric substitution.

nodes.title: Partial Fraction Decomposition
nodes.mastery_criteria: Student can integrate rational functions using partial fraction decomposition.

nodes.title: Differential Equations
nodes.mastery_criteria: Student can solve separable first-order differential equations and interpret slope fields.

nodes.title: Multivariable Calculus
nodes.mastery_criteria: Student can extend calculus to functions of several variables, including partial derivatives and multiple integrals.

nodes.title: Partial Derivatives
nodes.mastery_criteria: Student can compute partial derivatives and gradients of multivariable functions.

nodes.title: Double Integrals
nodes.mastery_criteria: Student can set up and evaluate double integrals over regions in the plane.

nodes.title: Triple Integrals
nodes.mastery_criteria: Student can set up and evaluate triple integrals over regions in space.

nodes.title: Vector Calculus
nodes.mastery_criteria: Student can apply gradient, divergence, and curl and use the integral theorems (Green's, Stokes', divergence).

nodes.title: Real Analysis
nodes.mastery_criteria: Student can construct rigorous epsilon-delta proofs about limits, continuity, and convergence.

nodes.title: Complex Analysis
nodes.mastery_criteria: Student can analyze functions of a complex variable, including analyticity and contour integration.

nodes.title: Linear Algebra
nodes.mastery_criteria: Student can analyze vector spaces and linear transformations and solve systems using matrix theory.

nodes.title: Eigenvalues
nodes.mastery_criteria: Student can compute eigenvalues and eigenvectors and diagonalize matrices.

nodes.title: Series
nodes.mastery_criteria: Student can analyze power series and Taylor/Maclaurin series and determine their intervals of convergence.

nodes.title: Abstract Algebra
nodes.mastery_criteria: Student can work with groups, rings, and fields and prove basic structural properties.

nodes.title: Number Theory
nodes.mastery_criteria: Student can prove and apply results about divisibility, primes, and congruences.

nodes.title: Advanced Number Theory
nodes.mastery_criteria: Student can apply advanced number-theoretic techniques such as quadratic reciprocity and analytic methods.

nodes.title: Discrete Mathematics
nodes.mastery_criteria: Student can apply logic, set theory, combinatorics, and graph theory to solve discrete problems.

nodes.title: Mathematical Logic
nodes.mastery_criteria: Student can construct formal proofs using propositional and predicate logic.

nodes.title: Combinatorics
nodes.mastery_criteria: Student can solve counting problems using permutations, combinations, and the inclusion-exclusion principle.

nodes.title: Modular Arithmetic
nodes.mastery_criteria: Student can perform arithmetic modulo n and apply congruences to solve problems.

nodes.title: Probability Theory
nodes.mastery_criteria: Student can apply axiomatic probability, random variables, and probability distributions to analyze uncertain events.

nodes.title: Applied Mathematics
nodes.mastery_criteria: Student can apply mathematical methods to model and solve problems in science and engineering.

nodes.title: Theoretical Mathematics
nodes.mastery_criteria: Student can develop and prove original theoretical results in an area of pure mathematics.

nodes.title: Mathematical Research Techniques
nodes.mastery_criteria: Student can formulate research questions, conduct a literature review, and produce original mathematical research.

nodes.title: Advanced Computational Methods
nodes.mastery_criteria: Student can implement and analyze numerical and computational algorithms to solve mathematical problems.

nodes.title: Differential Geometry
nodes.mastery_criteria: Student can analyze curves and surfaces using differential-geometric methods.

nodes.title: Topology
nodes.mastery_criteria: Student can reason about topological spaces, continuity, compactness, and connectedness.

nodes.title: Advanced Statistics
nodes.mastery_criteria: Student can apply advanced statistical inference and modeling techniques to analyze multivariable data.

nodes.title: Dilations
nodes.mastery_criteria: Student can dilate a figure by a scale factor about a center point and describe the effect on side lengths, angles, and coordinates.

nodes.title: Investments and Growth
nodes.mastery_criteria: Student can model investment growth over time using exponential and compound-interest models and compare growth scenarios.

nodes.title: Percent Increase and Decrease
nodes.mastery_criteria: Finds percent increase and decrease, markups, tips and discounts, and the percent change between two values.

nodes.title: Rate of Change
nodes.mastery_criteria: Finds and interprets a rate of change from a table, a graph, two points or a situation.

nodes.title: Linear Representations
nodes.mastery_criteria: Moves between a situation, a table, a graph and an equation for the same linear relationship.

nodes.title: Linear Modeling
nodes.mastery_criteria: Builds y = mx + b from a real situation, interprets slope and intercept in context, and uses it to predict.

nodes.title: Exponential Growth and Decay
nodes.mastery_criteria: Models repeated percent increase and decrease with a(1 ± r)^t and tells growth from decay.

nodes.title: Quadratic Graphs and Vertices
nodes.mastery_criteria: Reads a parabola: vertex, axis of symmetry, direction, roots and y-intercept, from a graph or an equation.

nodes.title: Modeling with Functions
nodes.mastery_criteria: Chooses a linear, exponential or quadratic model for a situation, uses it, and judges whether the answer makes sense.

nodes.title: Metric and Customary Conversion
nodes.mastery_criteria: Converts within the metric system and between metric and US customary units.

nodes.title: Dimensional Analysis
nodes.mastery_criteria: Tracks units through a calculation with conversion factors and uses units to check an answer.

nodes.title: Composite Area
nodes.mastery_criteria: Finds the area of composite shapes by adding and subtracting rectangles, triangles and circles.

nodes.title: Scale Drawings and Maps
nodes.mastery_criteria: Reads and makes scale drawings and maps, converting between drawing and real lengths and areas.

nodes.title: Questioning Data
nodes.mastery_criteria: Interprets displays and asks whether data supports a claim: source, sample, scale and missing context.

nodes.title: Comparing Function Families
nodes.mastery_criteria: Recognises and compares linear, quadratic, exponential, absolute-value and piecewise functions from equations, tables and graphs.

nodes.title: Multi-Step Problem Solving
nodes.mastery_criteria: Solves unfamiliar problems that need several skills in sequence, and keeps track of what each step found.

nodes.title: Estimation and Reasonableness
nodes.mastery_criteria: Estimates before calculating and judges whether a result is reasonable in size, sign and units.

nodes.title: Calculator Fluency
nodes.mastery_criteria: Enters calculations correctly (order of operations, parentheses, negatives, exponents) and reads calculator output including E notation.

nodes.title: Spreadsheet Formulas
nodes.mastery_criteria: Reads and writes spreadsheet formulas: cell references, SUM/AVERAGE, relative and absolute references when filled.

nodes.title: Personal Finance
nodes.mastery_criteria: Applies math to wages, paychecks, deductions, budgets, unit prices and simple debt.

nodes.title: Mathematical Communication
nodes.mastery_criteria: Chooses a correct justification, finds the error in a worked solution, and states a conclusion with units and context.

nodes.title: Applied Math Capstone
nodes.mastery_criteria: Solves substantial real-world scenarios that draw on several areas of mathematics at once.

nodes.title: Radical Equations
nodes.mastery_criteria: Solves equations containing square and cube roots and checks for extraneous solutions.

nodes.title: Advanced Modeling
nodes.mastery_criteria: Selects and builds polynomial, exponential, logarithmic and rational models and evaluates their fit.

nodes.title: Trig Equations
nodes.mastery_criteria: Solves trigonometric equations on an interval and in general form.

nodes.title: Logarithmic and Exponential Models
nodes.mastery_criteria: Models half-life, doubling time, continuous growth, pH and decibels with exponentials and logarithms.

nodes.title: Separable Differential Equations
nodes.mastery_criteria: Solves separable differential equations, including exponential growth and decay, with initial conditions.

nodes.title: Calculus Modeling
nodes.mastery_criteria: Applies derivatives and integrals to scientific and technical situations: rates, accumulation, net change.

nodes.title: Successive Percent Changes
nodes.mastery_criteria: Combines repeated or stacked percent changes and finds the overall change.

nodes.title: Loans and Amortization
nodes.mastery_criteria: Uses the loan payment formula and amortization tables to split payments into principal and interest.

nodes.title: Credit Card Math
nodes.mastery_criteria: Calculates credit-card interest from APR, minimum payments and the true cost of carrying a balance.

nodes.title: Mortgages
nodes.mastery_criteria: Calculates and compares mortgage payments, total interest, down payments and loan terms.

nodes.title: Investment Returns
nodes.mastery_criteria: Calculates gains, losses, return on investment and average annual return.

nodes.title: Inflation and Purchasing Power
nodes.mastery_criteria: Adjusts prices for inflation and compares purchasing power across years.

nodes.title: Tax Calculations
nodes.mastery_criteria: Estimates income tax with brackets, sales tax and property tax, and tells marginal from effective rate.

nodes.title: Revenue and Expenses
nodes.mastery_criteria: Builds revenue and cost expressions and analyses money entering and leaving a business.

nodes.title: Profit and Break-Even
nodes.mastery_criteria: Finds profit and the break-even point from revenue and cost models.

nodes.title: Margins and Markups
nodes.mastery_criteria: Calculates markup and margin, tells them apart, and sets prices to hit a target.

nodes.title: Financial Ratios
nodes.mastery_criteria: Uses profit margin, current ratio, debt-to-income and similar ratios to judge financial health.

nodes.title: Financial Spreadsheets
nodes.mastery_criteria: Reads and builds spreadsheet models for budgets, balances and loan schedules.

nodes.title: Data Collection Methods
nodes.mastery_criteria: Chooses surveys, observation, experiments or census, and writes unbiased questions.

nodes.title: Experimental Design
nodes.mastery_criteria: Designs experiments with control groups, random assignment, replication and blinding.

nodes.title: Probability Distributions
nodes.mastery_criteria: Builds and reads discrete probability distributions, including binomial, and finds their mean.

nodes.title: Normal Distribution Applications
nodes.mastery_criteria: Uses the empirical rule and the normal curve to estimate proportions and percentiles.

nodes.title: Choosing Data Displays
nodes.mastery_criteria: Chooses the right graph for the data and the question, and reads it correctly.

nodes.title: Misleading Statistics
nodes.mastery_criteria: Spots truncated axes, cherry-picked ranges, misleading averages and correlation-as-causation.

nodes.title: Spreadsheet Data Analysis
nodes.mastery_criteria: Analyses a dataset with AVERAGE, MEDIAN, COUNTIF, STDEV and sorting/filtering.

nodes.title: Data-Based Decisions
nodes.mastery_criteria: Uses evidence to support or reject a decision and states how strong that evidence is.

nodes.title: Forecasting
nodes.mastery_criteria: Forecasts from trend lines, moving averages and growth rates, and knows the limits of extrapolation.

nodes.title: Business Growth Models
nodes.mastery_criteria: Models business, population or customer growth and compares linear with exponential growth.

nodes.title: Cost-Benefit Analysis
nodes.mastery_criteria: Compares the costs and benefits of options, including payback period and net benefit.

nodes.title: Expected Value Decisions
nodes.mastery_criteria: Uses expected value to compare uncertain choices: insurance, warranties, games and investments.

nodes.title: Risk Analysis
nodes.mastery_criteria: Quantifies risk as probability times impact and compares options by both expected value and spread.

nodes.title: Constrained Optimization
nodes.mastery_criteria: Finds the best solution within constraints by testing the corners of a feasible region.

nodes.title: Scenario Modeling
nodes.mastery_criteria: Compares best, expected and worst cases when the assumptions in a model change.

nodes.title: Precision Measurement
nodes.mastery_criteria: Reads rulers to 1/16 inch, metric rules to the millimetre, calipers and micrometers.

nodes.title: Measurement Fractions
nodes.mastery_criteria: Adds, subtracts, halves and converts fractional inch measurements fluently.

nodes.title: Decimal Tolerances
nodes.mastery_criteria: Interprets plus/minus tolerances and decides whether a part is within spec.

nodes.title: Technical Drawings
nodes.mastery_criteria: Reads scaled plans and dimensioned drawings and finds missing dimensions.

nodes.title: Mixtures and Material Ratios
nodes.mastery_criteria: Calculates mixes and dilutions: concrete, fuel, paint, chemicals.

nodes.title: Trade Formulas
nodes.mastery_criteria: Uses trade formulas correctly: Ohm's law, board feet, tank capacity, gear and pulley ratios.

nodes.title: Error and Tolerance
nodes.mastery_criteria: Calculates absolute, relative and percent error and judges whether it is acceptable.

nodes.title: Significant Figures
nodes.mastery_criteria: Counts significant figures and reports calculated measurements at the right precision.

nodes.title: Applied Area
nodes.mastery_criteria: Calculates material areas for real jobs, subtracting openings and converting to square feet or yards.

nodes.title: Applied Volume
nodes.mastery_criteria: Calculates volumes of combined and irregular objects in job units such as cubic yards and gallons.

nodes.title: Pythagorean Layout
nodes.mastery_criteria: Uses 3-4-5 squaring, diagonals and rafter lengths in layout and construction.

nodes.title: Applied Trigonometry
nodes.mastery_criteria: Uses trig for heights, distances, angles of elevation and depression, and ramp or ladder angles.

nodes.title: Roof Pitch and Angles
nodes.mastery_criteria: Converts between pitch (rise in 12), slope, percent and angle.

nodes.title: Rise, Run and Grade
nodes.mastery_criteria: Calculates percent grade, incline and elevation change for ramps, roads, drains and stairs.

nodes.title: Irregular Shapes
nodes.mastery_criteria: Breaks irregular shapes into measurable sections and estimates areas from offsets.

nodes.title: Coordinate Layout
nodes.mastery_criteria: Locates points from a datum with coordinates and offsets, and finds distances between them.

nodes.title: Material Estimation
nodes.mastery_criteria: Determines how many boards, sheets, bags or yards a job needs, rounding up to whole units.

nodes.title: Waste Factors
nodes.mastery_criteria: Adds waste and overage allowances and works out yield from stock lengths.

nodes.title: Load and Rate Calculations
nodes.mastery_criteria: Calculates flow rates, electrical loads, fill and drain times, and weight loads.

nodes.title: Proportional Scaling
nodes.mastery_criteria: Enlarges or reduces designs and recipes correctly, including area and volume scaling.

nodes.title: Production Rates
nodes.mastery_criteria: Calculates output over time, combined work rates and time to finish a job.

nodes.title: Cost Estimation
nodes.mastery_criteria: Estimates project material and labour costs with markup and tax.

nodes.title: Efficiency
nodes.mastery_criteria: Compares useful output with resources consumed: efficiency %, fuel economy, energy use.

nodes.title: Spreadsheet Estimating
nodes.mastery_criteria: Builds and reads technical estimates in spreadsheets: quantities, unit costs, totals.

nodes.title: Technical Charts
nodes.mastery_criteria: Reads specification tables, span tables, wire-gauge charts and performance graphs.

nodes.title: Technical Capstone
nodes.mastery_criteria: Completes multi-part technical projects from drawing to material list to cost.

nodes.title: Binary Numbers
nodes.mastery_criteria: Converts between binary, decimal and hexadecimal and counts what n bits can represent.

nodes.title: Boolean Logic
nodes.mastery_criteria: Evaluates AND, OR, NOT and XOR expressions, builds truth tables and simplifies conditions.

nodes.title: Screen Coordinates
nodes.mastery_criteria: Uses pixel coordinates with y pointing down, origins, offsets and converting to and from math coordinates.

nodes.title: Functions in Code
nodes.mastery_criteria: Traces variables, functions, loops and integer division the way a program evaluates them.

nodes.title: Randomness in Code
nodes.mastery_criteria: Turns random() into ranges and integers and finds the probability of each outcome.

nodes.title: Computational Estimation
nodes.mastery_criteria: Approximates efficiently: orders of magnitude, powers of two, iterations and storage sizes.

nodes.title: Game Vectors
nodes.mastery_criteria: Uses 2D vectors for movement: components, adding, scaling, length and normalising.

nodes.title: Direction and Rotation
nodes.mastery_criteria: Finds headings and angles between objects and converts angles to direction vectors.

nodes.title: Velocity in Games
nodes.mastery_criteria: Updates position from velocity per frame and per second, with frame time.

nodes.title: Acceleration in Games
nodes.mastery_criteria: Updates velocity from acceleration, gravity and friction, step by step.

nodes.title: Collision Detection
nodes.mastery_criteria: Decides when rectangles, circles and points overlap.

nodes.title: Interpolation
nodes.mastery_criteria: Uses linear interpolation (lerp) to find values, positions and colours between known points.

nodes.title: Probability Systems
nodes.mastery_criteria: Builds drop tables and repeated-roll systems and finds the chance of at least one success.

nodes.title: Weighted Randomness
nodes.mastery_criteria: Converts weights to probabilities and picks outcomes with cumulative weights.

nodes.title: Difficulty Scaling
nodes.mastery_criteria: Designs and compares linear, exponential and capped difficulty curves.

nodes.title: Exponential Progression
nodes.mastery_criteria: Builds and analyses levelling curves: XP per level, total XP and growth factors.

nodes.title: Economy Balancing
nodes.mastery_criteria: Balances prices, rewards and resource rates so progress takes the intended time.

nodes.title: Matrix Transformations
nodes.mastery_criteria: Uses 2x2 matrices to scale, reflect and rotate points.

nodes.title: 3D Coordinates
nodes.mastery_criteria: Locates points in 3D, finds 3D distance and midpoint, and reads axis conventions.

nodes.title: Dot and Cross Products
nodes.mastery_criteria: Uses the dot product for angles and facing, and the cross product for perpendiculars and turn direction.

nodes.title: Graph Theory
nodes.mastery_criteria: Models networks with vertices and edges: degree, paths, cycles and shortest paths.

nodes.title: Algorithmic Complexity
nodes.mastery_criteria: Compares how algorithms scale with Big-O: constant, logarithmic, linear, quadratic, exponential.

nodes.title: Simulation and Modeling
nodes.mastery_criteria: Steps a simple simulation through its states and predicts its behaviour.

nodes.title: Quadratics by Square Roots
nodes.mastery_criteria: Solves x^2 = k and (x - h)^2 = k by square roots, including two, one or no real solutions, and picks the best method for a quadratic.

nodes.title: Rational Expression Arithmetic
nodes.mastery_criteria: Multiplies, divides, adds and subtracts basic algebraic fractions and states the excluded values.

nodes.title: Extraneous Solutions
nodes.mastery_criteria: Solves rational and radical equations, checks every candidate, and rejects values that zero a denominator or fail the original equation.

nodes.title: Nonlinear Function Analysis
nodes.mastery_criteria: Finds domain, range, intercepts, maximum or minimum, increasing and decreasing intervals and end behaviour of quadratic, polynomial, exponential and absolute-value functions.

nodes.title: Nonlinear Modeling
nodes.mastery_criteria: Chooses between linear, quadratic and exponential models from data and situations, builds the model, and uses it to predict and judge fit.
